ei.title: 3번: The Power of Community Over Drugs
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: The "Rat Park" was an experiment conducted by a psychologist in the late 1970s. It was used to show that a social community can be more powerful than drugs. In the experiment, rats were given a choice between two bottles, one containing plain water and the other containing water with morphine added to it. The psychologist found that rats kept together drank much less of the morphine water than rats kept alone. He concluded that addictive qualities aren't the only thing that promotes drug use. The social and environmental conditions of the individual also play an important role. This seems to apply to humans as well as rats. People who are lonely and isolated are more likely to become addicted to drugs. But if these conditions are improved, their chances of breaking the addiction increase. This means that social recovery could someday become a treatment for drug addiction.

questions.passage: The "Rat Park" was an experiment conducted by a psychologist in the late 1970s. It was used to show that a social community can be more (A)[powerful / weak] than drugs. In the experiment, rats were given a choice between two bottles, one containing plain water and the other containing water with morphine added to it. The psychologist found that rats kept together drank much (B)[more / less] of the morphine water than rats kept alone. He concluded that addictive qualities aren't the only thing that promotes drug use. The social and environmental conditions of the individual also play an (C)[important / trivial] role. This seems to apply to humans as well as rats. People who are lonely and isolated are more likely to become addicted to drugs. But if these conditions are improved, their chances of breaking the addiction increase. This means that social recovery could someday become a treatment for drug addiction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) powerful=강력한 / weak=약한 (B) less=더 적게 / more=더 많이 (C) important=중요한 / trivial=사소한
det.analysis:
① powerful—less—important: 사회적 공동체가 약물보다 강력하고, 함께 있던 쥐가 모르핀 물을 덜 마셨으며, 개인의 조건이 중요한 역할을 한다 ←정답
② weak: 약하다는 실험 결론(공동체가 더 강력)과 반대
③ more/trivial: 함께 있던 쥐는 더 적게 마셨고, 조건은 중요한 역할을 하므로 반대
④ weak/more: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: Rat Park 실험의 핵심: 공동체가 약물보다 powerful, 함께 있으면 less 섭취, 환경 조건이 important

The psychologist found that rats kept together drank much less of the morphine water than rats kept alone. The social and environmental conditions of the individual also play an important role. This seems to apply to humans as well as rats. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) addictive=중독성 있는 / harmless=무해한 (B) promotes=촉진하다 / prevents=막다 (C) isolated=고립된 / connected=연결된
det.analysis:
① harmless: 중독성(addictive) 성질이 약물 사용을 촉진하므로 harmless는 반대
② addictive—promotes—isolated: 중독성 성질이 약물 사용을 촉진하지만 유일한 요인은 아니고, 외롭고 고립된 사람이 중독되기 쉽다 ←정답
③ prevents/connected: 촉진(promotes)과 고립(isolated)이 원문이므로 반대
④ harmless/prevents: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 중독성(addictive)이 약물 사용을 promotes하지만, 사회적으로 isolated된 조건도 중요

questions.passage: The "Rat Park" was an experiment conducted by a psychologist in the late 1970s. It was used to show that a social community can be more powerful than drugs. In the experiment, rats were given a choice between two bottles, one containing plain water and the other containing water with morphine added to it. The psychologist found that rats kept together drank much less of the morphine water than rats kept alone. He concluded that addictive qualities aren't the only thing that promotes drug use. The social and environmental conditions of the individual also play an important role. This seems to apply to humans as well as rats. People who are lonely and isolated are more likely to become addicted to drugs. But if these conditions are (A)[improved / worsened], their chances of (B)[forming / breaking] the addiction increase. This means that social (C)[relapse / recovery] could someday become a treatment for drug addiction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) improved=개선되다 / worsened=악화되다 (B) breaking=끊는 것 / forming=형성하는 것 (C) recovery=회복 / relapse=재발
det.analysis:
① worsened: 조건이 개선되면 중독을 끊을 가능성이 커지므로 악화(worsened)는 반대
② forming/relapse: 중독을 끊는(breaking) 것이고 사회적 회복(recovery)이 치료가 되므로 반대
③ improved—breaking—recovery: 조건이 개선되면 중독을 끊을 가능성이 커지고, 사회적 회복이 치료가 될 수 있다 ←정답
④ worsened/forming: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 조건이 improved되면 중독을 breaking할 가능성 증가 → social recovery가 치료법

det.korean: ① conducted=수행된 ② powerful=강력한 ③ less→more (부적절) ④ important=중요한

det.korean: ① choice=선택 ② addictive→harmless (부적절) ③ isolated=고립된 ④ improved=개선된
det.analysis:

det.korean: ① plain=(아무것도 안 든) 맹물의 ② concluded=결론지었다 ③ isolated=고립된 ④ increase→decrease (부적절)
det.analysis:

② concluded: 심리학자가 결론지었다 — 적절
③ isolated: 외롭고 고립된 사람 — 적절
④ decrease: 조건이 개선되면 중독을 끊을 가능성이 '감소'? 원문은 increase(증가) ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: break(끊다) → breaking(동명사). 전치사 of 뒤에는 동명사
det.analysis: break를 동명사 breaking으로 변환. 'chances of breaking the addiction' = '중독을 끊을 가능성' — 전치사 of의 목적어 자리에 동명사 필요
det.tip: 전치사 of + ___ → 동명사(-ing) → breaking

questions.passage: The "Rat Park" was an experiment conducted by a psychologist in the late 1970s. It was used to show that a __________ can be more powerful than drugs. In the experiment, rats were given a choice between two bottles, one containing plain water and the other containing water with morphine added to it. The psychologist found that rats kept together drank much less of the morphine water than rats kept alone. He concluded that addictive qualities aren't the only thing that promotes drug use. The social and environmental conditions of the individual also play an important role. This seems to apply to humans as well as rats. People who are lonely and isolated are more likely to become addicted to drugs. But if these conditions are improved, their chances of breaking the addiction increase. This means that social recovery could someday become a treatment for drug addiction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: morphine water=모르핀 물 / plain water=맹물 / social community=사회적 공동체 / drug addiction=약물 중독
det.analysis:
① morphine water: 모르핀 물이 약물보다 강력? 문맥 부적절
② plain water: 맹물이 약물보다 강력? 부적절
③ social community: 사회적 공동체가 약물보다 강력할 수 있음을 보여주는 실험 ←정답
④ drug addiction: 약물 중독이 약물보다 강력? 부적절
det.tip: 실험이 보여준 핵심 = ___ can be more powerful than drugs = social community(사회적 공동체)

The social and environmental conditions of the individual also play an important role. This seems to apply to humans as well as rats. People who are lonely and isolated are more likely to become addicted to drugs. But if these conditions are improved, their chances of breaking the addiction increase. This means that __________ could someday become a treatment for drug addiction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: drug use=약물 사용 / plain water=맹물 / drug addiction=약물 중독 / social recovery=사회적 회복
det.analysis:
① drug use: 약물 사용이 치료법이 된다? 문맥 부적절
② plain water: 맹물이 치료법? 부적절
③ drug addiction: 약물 중독이 중독의 치료법? 모순
④ social recovery: 사회적 회복이 언젠가 약물 중독의 치료법이 될 수 있다 ←정답
det.tip: 조건 개선 → 공동체 회복이 치료법. ___ could become a treatment = social recovery(사회적 회복)
